title: DET-28-01 detection queue entry — SSH credential-guessing against the honeynet decoy
event_type: Google SecOps detection/case queue entry, DET-28-01 (Repeated failed SSH auth from one source against the honeynet decoy), outcome fields as surfaced to the analyst

callouts.explanation: An outcome field the rule itself computed (set to 35 in the YARA-L logic) and that travels into the queue entry unchanged — the analyst reads it directly rather than re-deriving it from the raw matched events.

The other outcome field named in the surrounding text; here it reports 1 because every attempt in Figure 28.2 reused the same support/support pair, which is itself a useful triage signal distinguishing default-credential sweeps from credential-stuffing.
The entity pair the rule matched on — target.hostname pinned to the decoy is what makes a count as low as five sufficient to alert, per the False Positive Trap earlier in this section.
